classification_rule: Classify by the dominant oracle-repair mechanism. Direct means the first-order dependency's visible package/API/signature/type surface changed. Indirect means behavior, dependency resolution, configuration/tooling, or generated output changed without a primary first-order API surface break.
evidence_basis: hidden test patch and verifier witness

mechanism_counts.description: Package, module, import path, namespace, or export relocation.
A dependency API symbol was removed, renamed, or replaced.
Arguments, return values, constructors, sync/async use, or call protocol changed.
A dependency-exposed type, interface, field, generic, or schema shape changed.
The callable surface remained usable but runtime meaning or behavior changed.
A transitive dependency, resolution result, bundled component, or interaction changed.
Configuration, compiler/linter policy, build system, test runner, or packaging changed.
Generated code, serialized data, SQL, formatting, snapshots, or textual output changed.
